'''Elandria Borndat''' was a historical author who wrote ''[[Seeing Through the Breaking]]'', a history of the [[War of Power]] that contained information on [[Mesaana]].{{ref/book|13|15}}
== Trivia ==
* Elandria Borndat is named for Kine Elandra Bjørnsdatter Haug, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
